name: After § 2
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: 2a. Condemns in the strongest terms the instrumentalisation of rule of law conditionality for politically motivated ideological assaults on Member States; emphasises that in these assaults, the Commission has demonstrably utilised and financed NGOs and left-leaning media outlets through EU funds; demands, consequently, an immediate cessation of these attacks against national sovereignty, which are perpetrated through the misuse of rule of law conditionality;
